tips_en: Start with EnvACE (Paper 3), as its 'world rehearsal' paradigm—internalizing the environment within a single shared policy—is the most conceptually novel and paradigm-shifting of the three, and it elegantly sidesteps both the data-generation bottleneck and the credit-assignment challenges addressed by the other papers. Read RST (Paper 2) next for a practical complement: it tackles the complementary problem of cheaply producing long-horizon training tasks, which is exactly the kind of scalable data EnvACE-style methods need. AgentOPSD (Paper 1) is a focused algorithmic contribution on turn-level credit assignment that nicely rounds out the trilogy—together the three papers cover the 'where to train' (EnvACE), 'what to train on' (RST), and 'how to assign credit' (AgentOPSD) dimensions of long-horizon agentic RL.
tips_z h: 建议先读 EnvACE（论文3），其'世界预演'范式——将环境内化到单个共享策略中——是三篇中最具概念新颖性和范式突破性的工作，并且巧妙地绕过了另外两篇论文所解决的数据生成瓶颈和信用分配挑战。接下来读 RST（论文2）作为实践补充：它解决了廉价生成长周期训练任务的互补问题，这正是 EnvACE 类方法所需的规模化数据。AgentOPSD（论文1）则聚焦于轮次级信用分配的算法贡献，恰好为这一三联画画上句号——三篇论文合在一起，覆盖了长周期智能体强化学习的'在哪里训练'（EnvACE）、'用什么训练'（RST）和'如何分配信用'（AgentOPSD）三个维度。
